name: you are the hero
source:
you are the hero is a visual novel.

A love triangle between the author, the viewer, and Jean-Paul Sartre’s concept of authentic freedom.

A game that only lies to the player once.

[Edited from [url=https://pizzapranks.itch.io/indiepocalypse-25]Indiepocalypse #25[/url]]
